The estimated total catch (numbers and pounds of each species) taken by all the fishermen fishing in Lake Jocassee during the indicated period. Also depicted are the average catch per hour of fishing (number and pounds) for each species, the average weight of each species and the average harvest per surface acre.
Source: South Carolina Wildlife and Marine Resources Department, 1976
Lake Jocassee
Period: January 1, 1974 through December 31, 1974
